hunts.frontierhunts.contract.how.doe: Counts an antlerless %1$s you take (a doe or cow).
hunts.frontierhunts.contract.how.rutbuck: Counts a %1$s buck with 8 or more points taken during the rut.
hunts.frontierhunts.contract.how.stalk: Counts a %1$s taken on foot that had not noticed you - no stand or blind.
hunts.frontierhunts.contract.how.bow: Counts a %1$s taken with a bow or crossbow.
hunts.frontierhunts.contract.how.trailed: Counts a %1$s you recovered after following its trail at least 30 m.
hunts.frontierhunts.contract.how.buckcam: Counts a trail camera photo of a %1$s buck or bull.
hunts.frontierhunts.contract.how.glass15: Counts a %1$s glassed with binoculars from 150 m or more.
hunts.frontierhunts.contract.how.water: Counts a %1$s taken while it stood in or beside water.
hunts.frontierhunts.contract.how.spread: Counts a %1$s taken over decoys or with a call.
journal.frontierhunts.rank_perk.greenhor: Greenhorn: finish the Ranger Academy and fill your first tag. Ranks open ranger services and counter discounts.
journal.frontierhunts.rank_perk.woodsman: Woodsman: the ranger's game report is open to you at any licence counter - where the herds are and what the rut is doing.
journal.frontierhunts.rank_perk.tracker: Tracker: game reports now count every group and tell you how many are bucks or bulls.
journal.frontierhunts.rank_perk.guide: Guide: 10% off licences, tags, stamps and ranger services.
journal.frontierhunts.rank_perk.master_h: Master Hunter: 20% off at the counter, and one more deer tag every season.
journal.frontierhunts.rank_perk.legend: Legend: your Hunting Licence and game reports are free, on top of 20% off and the extra deer tag.
journal.frontierhunts.home.perk_all: Woodsman: ranger's game report. Tracker: head counts in the report. Guide: 10% off at the counter. Master Hunter: 20% off and one more deer tag a season. Legend: free licence and reports. Journal XP comes from clean, legal, recovered harvests, tracking, contracts and the checklist.
licence.frontierhunts.page.why_tokens: Reserve tokens are the reserve's money: earned from contracts, delivering meat and hides at the ranger board, and expedition work. They pay for licences, tags, stamps, ranger services, camp upgrades and ammunition.
licence.frontierhunts.page.tag.beta: Not on the reserve yet - listed for when this animal arrives. See Coming Soon in the Handbook.
licence.frontierhunts.page.report.status: The ranger's survey of nearby herds and the rut
licence.frontierhunts.page.report.what: Direction and rough distance to the nearest whitetail, elk and moose groups within about 300 m, and the rut phase for each. Tracker rank adds head counts. One report every half day; free for Legends.
licence.frontierhunts.why.beta: This animal is not on the reserve yet - its tag can't be bought.
licence.frontierhunts.why.rank_woodsman: Reach Woodsman rank for ranger services.
licence.frontierhunts.why.report_wait: The ranger has nothing new yet - one report every half day.
licence.frontierhunts.why.vendor: Stand within 6 blocks of an Expedition Board, Ranger Contract Board, Ranger Window, Lodge Stores or your camp post (camp rank 1+).
journal.frontierhunts.soon.intro: What's on the way, and what the mod doesn't have yet.
journal.frontierhunts.soon.animals.text: Black bear, grizzly, polar bear, wild boar, bison, pronghorn, coyote, gray wolf, cougar, lion, panther and cheetah.
journal.frontierhunts.soon.animals.note: These are previews: they have spawn eggs but don't spawn on their own, have no contracts, and their tags are listed at the licence counter but can't be bought until they arrive.
journal.frontierhunts.soon.support.text: Frontier Hunts is made by one developer. If you enjoy it and want more animals sooner, you can support development on Ko-fi. It's never required and nothing in the game is locked behind it.
journal.frontierhunts.soon.support.note: Opens ko-fi.com/formaworks26954 in your browser (Minecraft asks first).
journal.frontierhunts.check.freak_whitet: Legend hunt: master the whitetail hunt, hear the ranger's rumour, find his sign on camera, hunt his country in the rut, then take him legally.
journal.frontierhunts.check.freak_elk.hi: Legend hunt: master the elk hunt, hear the ranger's rumour, glass bulls from 200 m, take a 10+ point bull in the rut, then take him legally.
Legend hunt: master the moose hunt, hear the ranger's rumour, photograph bulls, take a 14+ point bull in the rut, then take him legally.
academy.frontierhunts.plate.clean.aim: Broadside: aim just behind the front leg
academy.frontierhunts.plate.archery.targ: 3D target at 25 m: practise every distance
academy.frontierhunts.plate.stalk.head: Move only while her head is down
academy.frontierhunts.plate.range.zero: Zero at 100 m before you hunt
academy.frontierhunts.plate.dressing.tag: Tag it first, then dress it
academy.frontierhunts.plate.dressing.bag: Game bags keep the meat clean
academy.frontierhunts.plate.track.print: Fresh: sharp edges, water in the print
academy.frontierhunts.plate.tracking.dro: Blood: follow it drop by drop
journal.frontierhunts.path.complete: Every stage complete. A legend of the reserve.
